title: Winter Practice Period Shuso's Class - Continuing Our Maturity Part 3
speaker: Shin-yu Scott Allen
summary: Shin-yu Scott Allen emphasizes that true growth and maturity come from persisting in our efforts with faith and determination, even when faced with frustration or obstacles. This persistence requires taking a long-range view, recognizing that not every action will have the desired outcome, and continuing to act with wisdom and kindness nonetheless. By cultivating this mindset, we can break free from patterns of anger and negativity passed down from our parents and develop a more compassionate sense of self.
